prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup, EDIT / redesign of the supplied theater reader concept.
Create a new much more minimal iteration of the supplied side-by-side light/dark German Flutter script reader. Preserve the same two-screen composition, production, invented dialogue, warm ivory #F8F6F0 / dark forest #171C19 palette, dark ink #202823 and burnt-orange accents #E96131. Both are perfectly straight flat mobile screen designs, not physical device photos. Landscape comparison board with small captions "Drehbuch · Hell" and "Drehbuch · Dunkel", tiny outer note "Entwurf mit Beispieltext". Extremely crisp legible typography and pixel-sharp controls.
PRIMARY CHANGE: let the script read like a beautifully typeset script, with much less interface chrome. No repeated "ANWEISUNG", "LICHT", "DEIN TEXT" labels. No technical callout cards in the default reading view. Actual necessary stage directions remain as short subdued italic text directly in the script. Hide filter/mode complexity in one compact top picker and the overflow menu. Remove the large card behind the scene title, remove the segmented mode bar, remove all large orange dialogue fills, remove the always visible large live-session status strip.
Exact screen layout for BOTH:
One thin top toolbar: back arrow, small title "Wenn das Licht angeht", search icon, three dot overflow. Beneath it one quiet unboxed row "Szene 1 ⌄" at left, "LENA · Lesen ⌄" at right. A fine divider.
Content starts with modest heading "Ein Schlüssel fehlt", small plain line "LENA · OSKAR". Then ample clean script text with names in small uppercase. No boxed rows.
Italic "Lena wartet vor einer verschlossenen Tür."
OSKAR
"Du bist ja schon da."
LENA
"Ich wollte vor der Probe noch einmal hineinsehen."
OSKAR
"Dann fehlt uns nur noch der Schlüssel."
Italic "Oskar sucht in seinen Taschen."
LENA
"Schau bitte in deiner Jackentasche."
OSKAR
"Da ist er. Jetzt können wir anfangen."
BOTH LENA speeches use the same restrained highlight: role name in burnt orange and a very thin short orange rule in the left margin aligned to the speech, NO background fill, NO badge. All OSKAR speeches neutral.
One tiny outline comment bubble with the number 1 in the outer margin beside one LENA speech indicates an existing annotation, without displaying a whole note card.
Bottom slim fixed toolbar separated by a hairline: text link "Szenen", previous chevron, small label "Einsatz", next chevron, then small outline speech-bubble and small outline bookmark at far right. Keep notes/comments and bookmarks accessible but visually quiet, no rectangular buttons around each icon. The icons are small but allocated touch areas remain generous. A very small unobtrusive "Offline gespeichert" line may appear just above the toolbar, no status pill.
Use 18-20 px body text, comfortable line height, thin dividers only where essential. No large UI cards, no decorative typography, no marketing, no background illustrations or textures, no glows, no gradients. Light and dark modes must have identical content and hierarchy. This is an intentional calm reader redesigned from the provided reference.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one polished high fidelity design board for the German Flutter theater app "Rampenlicht", showing THREE straight-on portrait mobile screens side by side representing the attendance RESPONSE flow for ONE upcoming rehearsal. Reference image is the existing app style, not an edit target. Preserve warm ivory #F8F6F0, charcoal forest #202823, restrained orange #E96131, sage #32775D, rounded native controls, bold but restrained headings. Use flat screenshot quality, no realistic phones, no perspective, no decorative imagery, no fabricated charts. Small captions outside each screen: "Rückmeldung offen", "Zugesagt", "Absagen". Tiny board footer "Entwurf mit Beispieldaten". All German text crisp and readable.
These are MEMBERS replying in advance, NOT an admin marking physical presence. Use "Zugesagt" for saved yes, never "Anwesend".
Screen 1 open response:
Compact top bar back arrow, "Deine Probe", share icon. Small production line "Wenn das Licht angeht". Heading "Szenenprobe". A compact simple metadata area with clean icons and text:
"Donnerstag, 17. September"
"19:00 bis 21:00"
"Kolpingheim · Großer Saal"
Fine divider.
Heading "Bist du dabei?"
small unobtrusive amber status "Noch offen".
Two equally substantial side by side touch controls: dark forest/green filled with check icon "Bin dabei", neutral outlined with x icon "Kann nicht". This is a quick response, no additional save button on this screen.
Below small sentence "Rückmeldung bis 16. September".
Then heading "Wir proben", two subtle chips "Szene 1" "Szene 2". A compact row "Ein Schlüssel fehlt" with a book icon and next arrow, next row "Die Probe beginnt" with next arrow. Small line "Die Szene öffnet sich im Drehbuch."
At bottom simple links "In Kalender übernehmen" and "Längere Abwesenheit eintragen". No global bottom navigation on this event detail screen.
Screen 2 same page after successful server confirmation, identical metadata and scene links. In response area show pale sage strip with check icon and text "Du hast zugesagt". Under it quiet text "Deine Rückmeldung ist gespeichert." Selected green "Bin dabei" control with visible check, neighboring outlined "Kann nicht". A small text action "Rückmeldung zurücknehmen". Keep date/location and script links visible. This is an ordinary stable saved state, no confetti, no celebration, no modal.
Screen 3 same event dimmed very lightly behind an open native bottom sheet occupying lower 55 percent. Visible event title and metadata in upper half, sheet starts with a small drag handle and title "Probe absagen". Short plain text "Ein Grund ist freiwillig." A clearly labelled multiline field "Grund (optional)" with example value "Bin an diesem Abend unterwegs." and a modest character counter. Under it orange filled full-width button "Absage senden". A secondary text button "Abbrechen". Under submission button a quiet sentence "Du kannst deine Rückmeldung später ändern." No keyboard; the sheet and both buttons fully visible and comfortable for touch.
Professional real world rehearsal planning UI. Keep restrained surfaces and compact functional content matching the reference. Strong German text hierarchy, no repeated banners, no oversized hero art or long prose.

Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a polished high fidelity design board showing THREE MOBILE ADMIN SCREENS for "Rampenlicht", a German Flutter app for a theater ensemble. Supplied image is a style reference. Preserve warm ivory #F8F6F0, dark forest #202823, restrained burnt orange #E96131, sage and soft muted amber. Three flat straight-on portrait screens side by side, no perspective or device photography, small external captions "Probenleitung", "Anwesenheit", "Szenen planen", and bottom board note "Admin-Entwürfe mit Beispieldaten". Crystal clear German typesetting, comfortable touch targets, understated rounded controls. No marketing or charts.
Common fictional rehearsal: "Szenenprobe", "17. September · 19:00", "Kolpingheim", production "Wenn das Licht angeht".
SCREEN 1 admin overview:
top compact header "Probenleitung" with a small quiet badge "Admin", plus icon.
Dark forest feature panel title "Szenenprobe", date "17. September · 19:00", location "Kolpingheim". A SMALL section within this panel explicitly labelled "Rückmeldungen" with three text numbers "3 zugesagt", "1 abgesagt", "0 offen". Orange action "Anwesenheit erfassen".
Below a simple menu of 4 action rows separated by hairlines with restrained outline icons:
"Probe planen" chevron;
"Mitteilung schreiben" chevron;
"Ensemble verwalten" chevron;
"Produktionen & Besetzung" chevron.
Under a small heading "Als Nächstes", single plain agenda item "20. September · Technikprobe".
Bottom app navigation identical to reference: Heute, Termine, Drehbücher, Mein Bereich selected. The admin section is inside Mein Bereich.
SCREEN 2 admin physical check-in detail:
Top back arrow "Anwesenheit", small "Szenenprobe · 17. September".
Section label "Vor Ort", simple summary "2 da · 1 fehlt · 1 nicht erfasst". Small text "Status antippen zum Ändern."
Search field "Mitglied suchen".
Exactly FOUR member rows, each with a circular initials avatar, name and ROLE, plus one right-aligned outlined dropdown status control. Required exact states and data:
"Alex" / "LENA" / little subtext "Zugesagt" / status "Da ⌄" selected sage.
"Sam" / "OSKAR" / little subtext "Zugesagt" / status "Da ⌄" selected sage.
"Mira" / "FINN" / little subtext "Abgesagt" / status "Fehlt ⌄" muted terracotta.
"Robin" / "NORA" / little subtext "Zugesagt" / status "Nicht erfasst ⌄" neutral.
Use short linebreaks if needed, never confuse advanced RSVP with actual check-in. No toggles that imply unrecorded equals absent.
Below member list, small text row "Spielbare Szenen ansehen" with arrow.
At bottom full width orange button "Änderungen speichern". A small muted note "Erfasst wird die tatsächliche Anwesenheit." No global bottom nav in this subpage.
SCREEN 3 scene planning for that same rehearsal, based on the four actual check-in states above:
Back arrow "Szenen planen".
Small production selector "Wenn das Licht angeht ⌄".
A selected segmented control "Vor Ort" with inactive option "Zusagen". The scene feasibility here explicitly uses current actual presence, not RSVPs.
Small helper "Grundlage: erfasste Anwesenheit".
Exactly THREE rows with checkbox on left and textual feasibility:
checked "Szene 1 · Ein Schlüssel fehlt", subline "LENA · OSKAR", green status "Spielbar".
unchecked "Szene 2 · Die Probe beginnt", subline "FINN fehlt", muted terracotta status "1 Rolle fehlt".
unchecked "Szene 3 · Kurz vor Einlass", subline "NORA noch nicht erfasst", muted amber status "Ungeklärt".
Then a thin divider, summary "1 Szene ausgewählt".
Compact outlined row with book icon "Ausgewählte Szene öffnen" and arrow.
Bottom wide orange button "Für diese Probe speichern". No global bottom nav.
Maintain consistent sensible layout, clean spacing, distinguish colors with literal text, no ornamentation, no fake photos. Each screen is a realistic production-quality UI proposal. No actual backend/Flutter claims, just the design.
